default_referrer_rule: §7A: every signup attributed. Fallback chain valid-code → deep-link → context(agent/estate/campaign) → regional house → global house/super-admin. House = dedicated system account the Super Admin owns (NOT a personal wallet), seeded SPOT-HOUSE, overridable via env SUPER_ADMIN_REFERRAL_CODE / SUPER_ADMIN_USER_ID. House accruals non-withdrawable, excluded from override chains and K-factor, tagged house_default. Self/invalid code → house + risk flag. Late claim within grace window reassigns from house to real referrer (audited); house-benefiting reassignments require co-sign.
